guidelines: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1, H2, H3 headings to give a luxury, editorial travel magazine feel.
Use Manrope for body text, inputs, labels, and small UI elements for maximum legibility.
Headings should have tight tracking (tracking-tight) and slightly reduced line-height (leading-none for H1, leading-tight for others).
Overlines and small caps (like 'DESTINATIONS', 'EXPERIENCES') should use Manrope, uppercase, with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Ensure heading sizes fluidly scale but do not exceed text-6xl on desktop (e.g., text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl).
The site operates strictly in a dark, cinematic theme.
Backgrounds should utilize deep charcoal and very dark forest greens (almost black) to create depth.
Use 'beige' and 'terracotta' sparingly as warm accents for CTAs, active states, or highlight typography.
Text must meet APCA contrast ratios. Avoid pure white; use Mist White (#F5F7F5) for primary text.
Never use pure black or pure white.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain overlay (e.g., a repeating SVG background with opacity 0.03) to dark sections to remove digital flatness and enhance the cinematic editorial vibe.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with a highly transparent dark fill (bg-black/40) and a subtle 1px border (border-white/10) for the sticky navigation and floating elements.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, ambient shadows for floating widgets. Avoid harsh shadows; rely on 1px borders (border-white/10) to define edges.
visual_enhancers.image_overlays: Hero images must have a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#121513] via-black/40 to-black/20) to ensure text contrast while keeping the image visible.

libraries: framer-motion (for scroll reveals, parallax, and micro-interactions)

custom_patterns.buttons: Minimalist luxury. Primary: Warm accent bg with dark text, or glassmorphic outline with hover glow. No generic pill shapes; use rounded-none or rounded-sm for an editorial look.
custom_patterns.cards: Cardless or flat geometric approach. Images should do the heavy lifting. Avoid generic white/gray boxes. If background is needed, use #1A1E1C with a 1px border of white/5.
custom_patterns.trip_builder: Interactive segmented control or chips. Styled elegantly with a thin border and active states glowing slightly or turning terracotta/beige.

layouts_and_grids.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Background cinematic image. Text should be bottom-left aligned or centered with generous padding (pb-24 or pb-32) so the image breathes.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Ensure components have breathing room. Avoid cramped text.
layouts_and_grids.destinations_grid: Bento 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A). 6 destinations should not be equal squares. Create an asymmetrical layout (e.g., one large column spanning 2 rows, some wide, some tall) using grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gaps-6.
layouts_and_grids.packages: 3-column grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) with gap-8. Images should have a vertical aspect ratio (e.g., aspect-[3/4]) for a portrait/editorial look.
layouts_and_grids.general: Do not center-align the app container. All text and standard content should be left-aligned unless a specific section (like a quote or CTA block) demands centering.

motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis is mandatory to give a premium weight to the site.
motion.reveals: Use Framer Motion for subtle fade-up (opacity: 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) on scroll for text and cards.
motion.hover: Images inside cards should slowly scale up (scale 1.05) on hover with a slow ease transition (duration 0.6s). Do not use generic 'transition-all'.
motion.parallax: Apply subtle parallax (y movement) to hero background images or section backgrounds.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images or dark backgrounds is legible. Use text-shadow or gradients if needed.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must be visible, using a border ring of the terracotta/beige accent.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels for all icon-only buttons (like social links, floating WhatsApp, mobile menu).
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, form submissions, and cards MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

media.guidelines: Use these high-quality, cinematic nature images. Do NOT use placeholder text or dummy image services. Keep image overlay opacities reasonable so the photography shines. Apply aspect ratios (e.g., aspect-[3/4], aspect-square) to ensure consistency in grids.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust, multi-page layout (or single page with robust sections) containing: Cinematic Hero, Editorial Statement, Packages, Destinations Grid, Experiences, Trip Builder Form, Why Us, Testimonials, and Footer.
Implement the 'Custom Trip Builder' as an interactive component (e.g., Select/Chips for Destination, Style, Duration) using Shadcn primitives.
Ensure a floating contact widget (Call / WhatsApp) is always visible on the bottom right.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Strictly use the imported 'Cormorant Garamond'.
Do NOT center align the entire body or app container.
Avoid standard Vercel/SaaS aesthetics. This is a LUXURY TRAVEL brand. Think high fashion meets national geographic.
Apply data-testid to every clickable element.
Use Lucide React for icons. Do NOT use emojis.
Ensure all styling is done in pure Tailwind CSS + Shadcn. No external raw CSS files unless necessary for animations/lenis.
The UI must be heavily responsive (Mobile-first). Keep touch targets large and typography legible on small screens.
